segments.name: Banzai Operating Co, Inc.
segments.description: SaaS marketing and sales tools for businesses of all sizes, leveraging data, analytics and AI.
segments.evidence: The Company has three reportable operating segments, Banzai Operating Co, Inc., OpenReel, and Vidello.

segments.name: OpenReel
segments.description: AI-powered video creation platform for remotely recording, editing, hosting and sharing videos.
segments.evidence: OpenReel is an AI-powered video creation platform that enables users to remotely record, edit, host, and share high-quality videos from any location.

segments.name: Vidello
segments.description: Video hosting and marketing platform helping businesses manage, customize and optimize video content.
segments.evidence: Vidello is a comprehensive video hosting and marketing platform designed to help businesses manage, customize, and optimize their video content.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay recurring SaaS subscription licences for most products, on contracts from single months to multiple years.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell most of our products using a recurring subscription license model typical in SaaS businesses, with customer contracts that vary in term length from single months to multiple years.

changes.text: In 2025 Vidello was added as a reportable segment following its acquisition earlier that year.
changes.evidence: The Vidello acquisition occurred on January 31, 2025
